ticket.title: ServiceTicket
ticket.description: IT service request ticket submitted by clients or visitors.

clientId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitting user.

clientName.description: Full name of the client requesting service.

clientEmail.description: Contact email of the submitting client.

clientPhotoUrl.description: Optional Google avatar URL of the client.

priority.description: Urgency and SLA priority level of the service request.

siteLocation.description: Physical facility, room, or desk location requiring field dispatch.

status.description: Current workflow status of the IT request.

resolutionNotes.description: Chronological audit worklog and field notes appended by IT technicians.

lastResolutionNote.description: Most recent worklog excerpt or root-cause summary.

lastUpdatedBy.description: Name or email of the technician or client who last updated the ticket.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the ticket was opened.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest change or status update.

resolvedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the ticket was transitioned to Resolved.

techRole.title: TechRole
techRole.description: Designation for authorized IT Field Technicians or Admins.

/tickets/{ticketId}.description: Collection of all IT service requests. Clients can query and view tickets where clientId matches their auth UID. Authorized field technicians or admin (jawedimtiaz@gmail.com) can list all tickets, update workflow status, and log resolution notes.

/admins/{userId}.description: Authorized field technicians and IT administrator roster.
